Joshing QA walkthrough — production

Exploratory test of joshing-11.vercel.app at phone size, three accounts, friend / invite / block / gameplay / knowledge / cleanup.

Run 2026-09-25, 20:12–21:32 ET (EDT, UTC−4) · Tester: Claude (Opus 5.5) via Claude-in-Chrome · Accounts: A = Duo Prova (555-222-2222, kept), B = Trio Third (555-333-3333, deleted 21:24), C = Quad Prova (555-444-4444, created 20:57, deleted 21:27) · Screenshot IDs (s01…s111) match the timeline appendix

1. Overall summary

The core loop works: signup through an invite, the Daily Five, grading feedback, catch-up, friend requests, blocking, unblocking, invite links and account deletion all complete without errors, and no console errors were recorded on the screens checked. Blocking holds where it matters most: a blocked person cannot find, request, re-invite or re-join through a link, and unblocking does not bring the friendship back.

The biggest problems are about what is left behind, and about grading:

  • Deleted accounts leave their names in other people’s feeds, including real users (“Robyn”, “Joshua P”) who were never their friends (C1).
  • Blocking doesn’t clean the feed. Both sides keep seeing each other’s names and friendship events, and the names link to a bare 404 (C2).
  • Partly-right answers are marked wrong even when the grader itself says “right concept” / “right character” (C3). This goes against “fails toward the player”.
  • Several places disagree with each other: the home card vs. the summary dots, “noon” vs. “1 PM” on the same screen, “Ready when you are!” right after finishing, and skipped questions that vanish and then get spoiled on the summary.
  • Principle slips: the word streak on the home screen, and right/wrong dots that differ by color only.
Accounts after this run

A (Duo Prova, 555-222-2222) still exists. B (Trio Third) and C (Quad Prova) were deleted through the app. Both numbers now get “Joshing is invite-only”. Leftovers are listed in section 9.

How this run was done (read before judging timings or screenshots)

  • Viewport. resize_window had no effect on this machine. Screens 20:12–20:18 ran in a same-origin 390×844 frame (shots s00–s06 are cropped from it). From 20:18 on, a native tab at 393×703. Between ~21:01 and ~21:11 the window shrank itself to 316×564 (C’s gameplay, shots s70–s81). The desktop pass used a 1280-wide same-origin frame.
  • Hidden tab. Chrome reported the automation tab as visibilityState = hidden for the whole run. That throttles timers and painting, so slow loads (“Loading friends…” up to ~24 s), some faded animations and blank or partial screenshots are test artifacts, not filed as bugs.
  • One browser profile. All tabs share cookies, so A, B and C could not be signed in at the same time. I switched accounts by logging out and in (each switch is in the timeline).
  • Database. Read-only SQL via the Supabase MCP was used to confirm state (follows, blocks, invites, users). No rows were written by hand.

3. Findings by area

3.1 Onboarding & auth

Worked: The invite landing reads Duo invited you to Joshing, a trivia game built for you…. The C (555-444-4444) bypass code works. Wrong codes show Code invalid or expired and 5 digits shows Enter the 6-digit code.. Returning logins for A and B work. A taken username shows That username is already taken. and greys out the button. Interest setup explains the disabled button (2 selected · pick at least 1 more / Pick at least 3 to start). An uninvited number shows Joshing is invite-only. Ask a friend who’s already on Joshing to send you an invite., and the page scrolls so the message is visible (bottom 668 of 703 px).

Problems:

  • There is no way to resend a code on the code screen, only Change number (N6).
  • Get a text when your five open comes back at every login, even after Not right now (S11).
  • On the profile step, a stale Enter your display name. error stays up after the name is filled in, and the username auto-fill fights typing (S18). Placeholders read Jane Palay / jpalay (N7).
  • There is no avatar step. What’s required: name, username, 3 topics. Skippable: texts (I’ll check back on my own) and the tour.
  • C was never told they are now friends with Duo (see S1).

Principle check: no streaks, guilt or urgency in onboarding copy. Made from your topics, not pulled off a shelf. A new five lands every afternoon.

3.5 Invite system

  • Create: A was at 3 of 3 links, so A deleted the unused old Link 3 (in-app confirm, copy nit N9), then created “Renaissance Florence & Great Lakes shipwrecks” at 20:52. The sheet shows a red Choose at least one category to save. before any action (N10), and offers only 3 of A’s 15 territories.
  • C (fresh) via link: account created, A↔C friends instantly (DB 20:57:01). No on-screen confirmation that C is now Duo’s friend.
  • B (existing) via the same link, signing in from the link: A↔B friends instantly (21:16:13). B never saw an Accept screen and landed on the reminders ask (S1). The only sign was Duo Prova is now a friend in B’s feed.
  • B while blocked: This invitation is no longer available. Block holds.
  • Invalid / deleted / wrong-handle links: all show Invitation unavailable · This invitation link is no longer valid., but a signed-in viewer only gets Go to login (N13).
  • Already-used by the same person: C re-opening the link sees Accept Duo Prova’s invitation again, then is silently sent home (N13), and a duplicate Quad Prova is now a friend lands in A’s feed (S15).
  • Co-invitee auto-friending: B and C both joined through the same link. They were NOT made friends (0 follow rows). Neither was suggested to the other.
  • Counter: the link read 1 friend joined after both C and B joined through it (S14).

3.6 Desktop pass (differences only)

At 1280 px (scaled frame) the app is the same ~700 px column centered on the page, with the phone bottom tab bar kept (no side or top nav). The summary intro uses the full width (at phone width it’s squeezed beside the Share button, N19). The Five new tomorrow… Back home card floats mid-page over the question cards. The “+” button sits far right of the column. Nothing else differed.

5. Questions for Josh

  • Can players tell Maid Acasa is a bot? Not from the UI. It shows as by Maid Acasa / Asked by Maid Acasa, exactly like a person, next to by Joshua P. A small “Joshing’s writer” marker would avoid players thinking it’s a stranger.
  • Invite-link consent. The invite counting as consent is deliberate, but an existing user who signs in from a link becomes a friend without seeing who or what (S1). A one-line “You and Duo are now friends” would keep the rule and remove the surprise.
  • “Show me the answer” = red / “Not this time”. Choosing to look isn’t a wrong answer. Should it get its own neutral mark?
  • Generous grading on a different person. Lorenzo de Medici was accepted for Lorenzo di Pierfrancesco de’ Medici (a different man). That fits the principle, but it teaches a wrong fact unless the card points out the difference.
  • Ceremony on the way to the summary. A’s week was unviewed (feed said SEE IT NOW), yet /daily → /daily/summary at 20:15 went straight to the summary. Is the interstitial meant to show only right after finishing a round?
  • Anonymous stranger activity. C’s home showed Someone played their first five questions. It’s anonymous, but it’s still a stranger’s activity in a brand-new player’s feed.
  • Test accounts pinging real users. Test play created notifications for Robyn and Joshua P (C1). Should test numbers be excluded from niche-match and author notifications?
  • “FROM DUO’S WORLD” vs “you answered 0”. C answered two bonuses “from Duo’s world”, yet Friends says Questions created 2 (you answered 0). The two phrases mean different things (topics vs authorship), which isn’t obvious.
  • Search rate limit. ~8 searches a minute. Fine for people, but friend-hunting by several phone numbers can hit it.

Contact matching and mutual-friend suggestionsBoth toggles were OFF on A and B, and I didn’t change A’s settingsTurn “Suggest me through mutual friends” on for two test accounts that share a friend
Console errors before 21:19read_console_messages only records after its first call, and my in-page error hook was lost when the first tab closedCall the console reader at the very start of the run
Load-time / performanceThe automation tab was hidden and throttledKeep the Chrome window in front during the run
A single consistent 390×844 viewportresize_window was ignored; the window resized itself mid-runUn-maximize and un-snap the Chrome window before starting, or run Chrome’s device emulation
Writing a question; answering a friend-written questionOut of the brief’s five areas; timeAdd to a future run

7. Principle audit

PrincipleVerdictEvidence
No streaks, leaderboards or coercive mechanicsmostlyNo leaderboards, counters or guilt copy seen. But TAP A STREAK TO PLAY YOUR FRIEND’S QUESTIONS (S8), and the text-reminder ask returns at every login (S11). Catch-up copy is gentle: Some you didn’t land will find their way back to you.
Wrong answers feel like connection momentsmostly passNOW IT’S IN YOURS TOO, You’ll know this one next time., BETWEEN US!, ARGUE YOUR POINT. Dents: screen-reader text says Wrong (N15), and appeals get no reply (N14).
Color never carries meaning alonefailRight/wrong dots are same-shape green/red on round, summary and home (S9). Mastery legend dots are indistinguishable (N11). Answer cards, frequency view and profile bubbles do pair color with text or icons.
Grading fails toward the playerfailTypos pass (Viena, Pittsburg, catch 22), but partly-right answers fail (the Queen, vanishing point, hunchback) while the feedback says they were close (C3).

8. Suggestions for improvement

  • One “partial credit” rule in the grader: if the explanation would start with “Right concept / right character / you’re close”, mark it correct and show the full answer as “the full name is …”. This turns C3 into a teaching moment instead of a miss.
  • Make the feed respect relationships at read time: hide items whose actor is blocked (either direction) or deleted, and label deleted actors consistently (“A former player”). Only use “friend_…” types when a friendship exists.
  • Give dots a second cue: ✓ inside green, ✕ inside red, a small arc for skipped, and use the same glyphs on round, summary and home. Build the home dots from the same data as the summary so they can’t drift (S5).
  • Say “friends now” once: a one-time toast when an invite link creates a friendship, for both the joiner and the inviter, plus You’re already friends when a friend re-opens a link.
  • Keep skipped questions visible: leave the card in place with “Skipped · coming back another day”, and hide its answer on the summary until it has come back.
  • One source for the next-round time: the recap card, summary footer, onboarding and home should all read from the same helper.
  • Replace “streak” in the friends strip with “Tap a friend to play their questions.”
  • Remember “Not right now” for the text ask (e.g. re-ask after 14 days or never), matching the product’s low-pressure tone.
  • Blocked states: a styled “This profile isn’t available” page, and on the blocker’s side “You’ve blocked this person · Manage blocked people” instead of a bare 404 or “breathing room”.
  • Bot clarity: a small “Joshing’s question writer” tag next to Maid Acasa.
